Sunder
30 Energy
8 sec cooldown
Consumes 2 Felfury
Sunder the ground progressively infront of you, causing 3 explosions one after another that deal 245*$+AP*0.2+SP*.25 Chaos Damage, split amongst all enemies struck, plus (12*1000/3)*(95*$+AP*0.12) over 12 sec.

Inner Demon: Affected enemies have their attack power reduced by (-23+1.0 Points Per Level)* -1 for 20 sec.
